import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional plot style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')

# Create the figure and axes
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))

# Create a multi-dimensional scatter plot (bubble chart)
# This allows us to visualize relationships between price, megapixels, ISO, brand, and body type.
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='brand',
    size='max_iso',
    style='body_type',
    sizes=(200, 2000),
    palette='viridis',
    ax=ax,
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.75,
    legend='full'
)

# Add annotations for each point to provide more context
for i in range(df.shape[0]):
    ax.text(
        x=df['megapixels'][i] + 0.5,
        y=df['price_usd'][i] + 50,
        s=f"{df['brand'][i]} ({df['model_year'][i]})",
        fontdict=dict(color='black', size=11)
    )

# --- Customize plot aesthetics for clarity and impact ---

# Set title and labels
ax.set_title('Camera Feature Analysis: Price vs. Megapixels', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', pad=25)
ax.set_xlabel('Megapixels (MP)', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)

# Format y-axis ticks as currency
formatter = FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f'${int(x):,}')
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)

# Customize tick parameters
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)

# Move and style the legend
# Place it outside the plot to avoid obscuring data
h, l = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate legends for clarity
legend1 = ax.legend(h[1:4], l[1:4], title='Brand', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=11, title_fontsize=13)
ax.add_artist(legend1)
legend2 = ax.legend(h[5:8], l[5:8], title='Body Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.75), loc='upper left', fontsize=11, title_fontsize=13)
ax.add_artist(legend2)
legend3 = ax.legend(h[9:], l[9:], title='Max ISO', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.45), loc='upper left', fontsize=11, title_fontsize=13)

# Adjust layout to make room for the legend
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1])

# Save the resulting visualization
